---
title: "Séries temporelles"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d/%m/%Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    theme:
      version: 5
      bg: "#EEF9FD"
      fg: "#271D67"
      primary: "#1AADE7"
      secondary: "#271D67"
      base_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
      heading_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
params:
  data_file: "data"         # nom du fichier JSON (avec ou sans extension), dans le MÊME dossier que ce Rmd
  geo: "LU, BE"             # pays chargés, séparés par des virgules (ex. "LU", "LU, BE") ; "ALL" = tous les pays du fichier
  product: "TOTAL"          # produit affiché à l'ouverture (code ou nom) ; un seul produit à la fois sur le graphique
  indicator: ""             # indicateur affiché à l'ouverture (ex. "VALUE_IN_EUROS") ; "" = celui en euros, sinon le premier
  flow: "import"            # flux affiché à l'ouverture : "import" ou "export"
  freq: "monthly"           # fréquence à l'ouverture : "monthly" ou "annual"
  agg: "sum"                # agrégation des lignes en double et des mois vers l'année : "sum" ou "mean"
  geo_col: ""               # colonne pays ; "" = détection automatique (nom usuel, sinon colonne contenant les codes de params$geo)
  product_col: "product"
  indicator_col: "indicators"
  flow_col: "flow"          # colonne du flux ; si introuvable, la colonne contenant IMPORT / EXPORT est utilisée
  time_col: "TIME"
  value_col: "OBS_VALUE"
  pq_geo: "LU"              # Partie 2 (prix / quantités) : pays analysé
  pq_min_obs: 36            # Partie 2 : nombre minimum de variations mensuelles pour estimer la régression
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)
```

```{r load-data}
# ---- 1. Localiser le fichier JSON à côté de ce Rmd ------------------------------------------
RMD_DIR <- local({
  d <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d)) getwd() else dirname(d)
})

JSON_EXT <- c("json", "jsonl", "ndjson")

locate_data <- function(dir, name) {
  direct <- file.path(dir, name)
  if (file.exists(direct) && !dir.exists(direct)) return(normalizePath(direct, winslash = "/"))
  files <- list.files(dir, full.names = TRUE)
  cand  <- files[tolower(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))) == tolower(name) &
                 tolower(tools::file_ext(files)) %in% JSON_EXT]
  if (length(cand) == 0) stop("Aucun fichier '", name, ".json' trouvé dans : ", dir)
  normalizePath(cand[1], winslash = "/")
}

DATA_PATH <- locate_data(RMD_DIR, params$data_file)

# ---- 2. Lire le JSON et en extraire la table principale -------------------------------------
TIME_NAMES <- c("TIME", "TIME_PERIOD", "year", "time", "annee", "année", "period")

# Format JSON-stat (ex. API Eurostat) : dimensions + vecteur "value" -> table à plat.
# Les libellés des modalités (code -> nom) sont conservés dans l'attribut "labels".
jsonstat_to_table <- function(x) {
  ids   <- as.character(unlist(x$id))
  cats  <- lapply(ids, function(d) x$dimension[[d]]$category)
  codes <- lapply(cats, function(ct) {
    idx <- ct$index
    if (is.null(idx)) idx <- names(ct$label)
    if (!is.null(names(idx))) names(sort(unlist(idx))) else as.character(unlist(idx))
  })
  names(codes) <- ids
  labels <- lapply(cats, function(ct) unlist(ct$label))
  names(labels) <- ids

  # JSON-stat : la dernière dimension varie le plus vite
  grid <- do.call(expand.grid, c(rev(codes), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))[, ids, drop = FALSE]
  v <- x$value
  vals <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(grid))
  if (is.list(v) || !is.null(names(v))) {           # format « creux » : { "index": valeur }
    vals[as.integer(names(v)) + 1L] <- as.numeric(unlist(v))
  } else {
    vals[seq_along(v)] <- as.numeric(v)
  }
  res <- as_tibble(grid) %>% mutate(value = vals)
  attr(res, "labels") <- labels
  res
}

read_json_table <- function(path) {
  x <- tryCatch(fromJSON(path, flatten = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(x)) return(as_tibble(stream_in(file(path), verbose = FALSE, flatten = TRUE)))   # NDJSON

  if (is.list(x) && all(c("id", "size", "dimension", "value") %in% names(x))) return(jsonstat_to_table(x))

  # Cherche tous les data frames imbriqués ; garde celui qui contient une colonne temps (puis le plus grand)
  find_df <- function(o) {
    if (is.data.frame(o)) return(list(o))
    if (is.list(o)) return(do.call(c, lapply(o, find_df)))
    NULL
  }
  dfs <- find_df(x)
  if (length(dfs) == 0) {
    cat("Structure du JSON :\n"); str(x, max.level = 2, list.len = 10)
    stop("Aucune table (liste d'enregistrements) trouvée dans ", path)
  }
  has_time <- vapply(dfs, function(d) any(tolower(names(d)) %in% tolower(TIME_NAMES)), logical(1))
  pool <- if (any(has_time)) dfs[has_time] else dfs
  as_tibble(pool[[which.max(vapply(pool, nrow, integer(1)))]])
}

raw <- read_json_table(DATA_PATH)
if (nrow(raw) == 0) stop("Le fichier ", DATA_PATH, " est vide.")
JSON_LABELS <- attr(raw, "labels")     # NULL si le JSON n'est pas au format JSON-stat

# ---- 3. Repérer les colonnes ----------------------------------------------------------------
find_col <- function(df, wanted, alternatives, exclude = character(0)) {
  for (p in unique(c(wanted, alternatives))) {
    if (!nzchar(p)) next
    hit <- setdiff(names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == tolower(p)], exclude)
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }
  NA_character_
}

COLS <- list(
  prod  = find_col(raw, params$product_col, c("product", "products", "produit", "produits", "prod")),
  time  = find_col(raw, params$time_col,    c("TIME", "TIME_PERIOD", "year", "time", "annee", "année", "period")),
  value = find_col(raw, params$value_col,   c("OBS_VALUE", "VALUE", "value", "values", "valeur"))
)
if (is.na(COLS$time)) stop("Colonne temps introuvable. Colonnes disponibles : ", paste(names(raw), collapse = ", "))
if (is.na(COLS$prod)) stop("Colonne produit introuvable (params$product_col). Colonnes disponibles : ", paste(names(raw), collapse = ", "))
if (is.na(COLS$value)) {
  num <- names(raw)[vapply(raw, is.numeric, logical(1)) & names(raw) != COLS$time]
  if (length(num) == 0) stop("Colonne de valeurs introuvable (params$value_col). Colonnes disponibles : ", paste(names(raw), collapse = ", "))
  COLS$value <- num[1]
}
COLS$ind <- find_col(raw, params$indicator_col, c("indicators", "indicator", "indic", "indicateur", "unit", "measure"),
                     exclude = unlist(COLS))

# Colonne du flux (import / export) : par son nom, sinon par ses valeurs
COLS$flow <- find_col(raw, params$flow_col, c("flow", "flows", "trade_flow", "stk_flow", "flux", "flow_code", "trade_type"),
                      exclude = unlist(COLS))
if (is.na(COLS$flow)) {
  cand <- setdiff(names(raw), unlist(COLS))
  cand <- cand[vapply(cand, function(cl) {
    x <- raw[[cl]]
    if (!(is.character(x) || is.factor(x))) return(FALSE)
    u <- toupper(unique(as.character(x)))
    length(u) <= 4 && any(str_detect(u, "IMP")) && any(str_detect(u, "EXP"))
  }, logical(1))]
  if (length(cand) > 0) COLS$flow <- cand[1]
}

# Colonne pays : 1) params$geo_col ou nom usuel ; 2) sinon la colonne qui contient les codes demandés (ex. LU et BE)
GEO_TOKENS <- toupper(trimws(strsplit(params$geo, ",")[[1]]))
GEO_TOKENS <- GEO_TOKENS[nzchar(GEO_TOKENS) & GEO_TOKENS != "ALL"]
GEO_NAME_RX <- "rep|decl|geo|country|pays|area|member"

COLS$geo <- find_col(raw, params$geo_col, c("geo", "country", "ref_area", "cntry", "pays", "reporter", "declarant",
                                            "reporter_code", "reporter_iso", "declarant_iso", "country_code",
                                            "geo_code", "member_state", "ms", "iso2", "iso"),
                     exclude = unlist(COLS))
if (is.na(COLS$geo)) {
  cand <- setdiff(names(raw), unlist(COLS))
  cand <- cand[vapply(cand, function(cl) is.character(raw[[cl]]) || is.factor(raw[[cl]]), logical(1))]
  cand <- if (length(GEO_TOKENS) > 0) {
    cand[vapply(cand, function(cl) all(GEO_TOKENS %in% toupper(unique(as.character(raw[[cl]])))), logical(1))]
  } else {
    cand[grepl(GEO_NAME_RX, cand, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  }
  if (length(cand) > 0) {
    pri <- grepl(GEO_NAME_RX, cand, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("partner", cand, ignore.case = TRUE)
    COLS$geo <- c(cand[pri], cand[!pri])[1]
  }
}

# Libellés des produits : JSON-stat si disponible, sinon une colonne de libellé voisine, sinon le code
prod_codes  <- as.character(raw[[COLS$prod]])
prod_labels <- prod_codes
LAB_COL     <- character(0)
lab_map <- if (!is.null(JSON_LABELS)) JSON_LABELS[[COLS$prod]] else NULL
if (!is.null(lab_map)) {
  hit <- unname(lab_map[prod_codes])
  prod_labels <- ifelse(is.na(hit) | hit == "", prod_codes, hit)
} else {
  LAB_COL <- names(raw)[tolower(names(raw)) %in% tolower(c(
    paste0(COLS$prod, c("_label", "_name", "_title", "_desc", "_libelle")), "label", "libelle", "libellé", "name", "nom", "title"))]
  LAB_COL <- head(setdiff(LAB_COL, unlist(COLS)), 1)
  if (length(LAB_COL) > 0) {
    hit <- as.character(raw[[LAB_COL]])
    prod_labels <- ifelse(is.na(hit) | hit == "", prod_codes, hit)
  }
}

# Autres dimensions du fichier (agrégées par params$agg) : affichées pour information
OTHER_DIMS <- setdiff(names(raw), c(unlist(COLS), LAB_COL))
OTHER_DIMS <- OTHER_DIMS[vapply(OTHER_DIMS, function(cl) {
  x <- raw[[cl]]; (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) && n_distinct(x) > 1
}, logical(1))]

# Période -> premier jour du mois. Formats acceptés : 2020-01, 2020M01, 2020-M01, 202001, 2020-01-15
parse_month <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(x, 1, 4)))
  m <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_match(x, "^\\d{4}[-_/ ]?[Mm]?(\\d{1,2})")[, 2]))
  m[is.na(m) | m < 1 | m > 12] <- 1L
  out <- as.Date(rep(NA_character_, length(x)))
  ok  <- !is.na(y)
  out[ok] <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", y[ok], m[ok]))
  out
}

dat <- tibble(
  GEO    = if (is.na(COLS$geo)) "(tous)" else as.character(raw[[COLS$geo]]),
  PROD   = prod_codes,
  PLABEL = prod_labels,
  IND    = if (is.na(COLS$ind)) "VALUE" else as.character(raw[[COLS$ind]]),
  FLOW   = if (is.na(COLS$flow)) "ALL" else as.character(raw[[COLS$flow]]),
  DATE   = parse_month(raw[[COLS$time]]),
  VAL    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw[[COLS$value]]))
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DATE), !is.na(VAL), !is.na(PROD), !is.na(IND), !is.na(FLOW))

dat_allgeo <- dat     # copie avant le filtre pays (utilisée par la partie 2)

# ---- 4. Pays --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (is.na(COLS$geo)) {
  GEOS <- "(tous)"
} else {
  avail <- sort(unique(dat$GEO))
  if (length(GEO_TOKENS) == 0) {
    GEOS <- avail
  } else {
    unknown <- GEO_TOKENS[!GEO_TOKENS %in% toupper(avail)]
    if (length(unknown) > 0) stop("Pays introuvable(s) dans la colonne '", COLS$geo, "' : ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
                                  ". Valeurs disponibles : ", paste(head(avail, 50), collapse = ", "))
    GEOS <- avail[match(GEO_TOKENS, toupper(avail))]       # ordre donné dans les paramètres
  }
  dat <- filter(dat, GEO %in% GEOS)
}
GEO_LAB <- setNames(GEOS, GEOS)
if (!is.na(COLS$geo) && !is.null(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$geo]])) {
  gl <- unname(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$geo]][GEOS]); GEO_LAB <- setNames(ifelse(is.na(gl), GEOS, gl), GEOS)
}
GEO_PALETTE <- c(COL_BLUE, COL_ORANGE, COL_LAVEND, COL_GREEN, COL_RED, COL_PINK)
GEO_COL     <- setNames(rep_len(GEO_PALETTE, length(GEOS)), GEOS)

# ---- 5. Indicateurs -------------------------------------------------------------------------
IND_CODES <- sort(unique(dat$IND))
ind_label <- function(code) {
  jl <- if (!is.na(COLS$ind) && !is.null(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$ind]])) unname(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$ind]][code]) else NA_character_
  up <- toupper(code)
  case_when(
    !is.na(jl) & jl != "" ~ jl,
    str_detect(up, "EURO")             ~ "Valeur (\u20ac)",
    str_detect(up, "100 ?KG")          ~ "Quantité (100 kg)",
    str_detect(up, "KG")               ~ "Quantité (kg)",
    str_detect(up, "SUPP")             ~ "Unités supplémentaires",
    TRUE                               ~ code
  )
}
IND_LAB <- setNames(ind_label(IND_CODES), IND_CODES)
DEFAULT_IND <- {
  hit <- IND_CODES[toupper(IND_CODES) == toupper(params$indicator)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- IND_CODES[str_detect(toupper(IND_CODES), "EURO")]
  if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- IND_CODES
  hit[1]
}
# ---- 5b. Flux (import / export) -------------------------------------------------------------
# Codes usuels : 1 / IMP / IMPORT / M = import ; 2 / EXP / EXPORT / X = export
FLOW_CODES <- unique(dat$FLOW)
flow_kind <- function(code) {
  up <- toupper(trimws(code))
  case_when(up %in% c("1", "M") | str_detect(up, "^IMP") ~ "import",
            up %in% c("2", "X") | str_detect(up, "^EXP") ~ "export",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_)
}
FLOW_LAB <- setNames(
  vapply(FLOW_CODES, function(cd) {
    jl <- if (!is.na(COLS$flow) && !is.null(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$flow]])) unname(JSON_LABELS[[COLS$flow]][cd]) else NA_character_
    k  <- flow_kind(cd)
    if (!is.na(k)) c(import = "Import", export = "Export")[[k]] else if (!is.na(jl)) jl else cd
  }, character(1)),
  FLOW_CODES)
FLOW_CODES <- FLOW_CODES[order(match(flow_kind(FLOW_CODES), c("import", "export")), FLOW_CODES)]   # Import puis Export
FLOW_LAB   <- FLOW_LAB[FLOW_CODES]
DEFAULT_FLOW <- {
  want <- tolower(trimws(params$flow))
  hit  <- FLOW_CODES[flow_kind(FLOW_CODES) %in% want | tolower(FLOW_CODES) == want]
  if (length(hit) == 0) FLOW_CODES[1] else hit[1]
}

DEFAULT_FREQ <- if (tolower(params$freq) %in% c("annual", "annuel", "a", "y", "year")) "y" else "m"

# ---- 6. Produits (un seul affiché) ----------------------------------------------------------
PRODUCTS <- dat %>%
  distinct(PROD, PLABEL) %>%
  distinct(PROD, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(PROD) %>%
  mutate(DISPLAY = if_else(duplicated(PLABEL) | duplicated(PLABEL, fromLast = TRUE),
                           paste0(PLABEL, " (", PROD, ")"), PLABEL))

key <- function(x) tolower(trimws(x))
match_prod <- function(tok) which(key(PRODUCTS$PROD) == key(tok) | key(PRODUCTS$PLABEL) == key(tok) | key(PRODUCTS$DISPLAY) == key(tok))
first_hit <- head(c(match_prod(params$product), match_prod("TOTAL"), 1L), 1)
if (length(match_prod(params$product)) == 0) warning("Produit introuvable : ", params$product, " \u2013 affichage de : ", PRODUCTS$DISPLAY[first_hit])
PRODUCTS$SEL <- seq_len(nrow(PRODUCTS)) == first_hit

# ---- 7. Séries mensuelles et annuelles (pays x produit x indicateur) -------------------------
AGG_FUN <- if (tolower(params$agg) == "mean") mean else sum

ts_m <- dat %>%
  group_by(GEO, PROD, IND, FLOW, DATE) %>%
  summarise(VAL = AGG_FUN(VAL), .groups = "drop")

ts_y <- ts_m %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.integer(format(DATE, "%Y"))) %>%
  group_by(GEO, PROD, IND, FLOW, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(VAL = AGG_FUN(VAL), NM = n(), .groups = "drop")      # NM : nombre de mois disponibles

MONTHS <- sort(unique(ts_m$DATE))
YEARS  <- sort(unique(ts_y$YEAR))

# Valeurs alignées sur l'axe commun (NA = pas de donnée), une entrée par "pays|produit|indicateur|flux"
align <- function(d, pos, n, col) {
  keys <- paste(d$GEO, d$PROD, d$IND, d$FLOW, sep = "|")
  lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(d)), keys), function(ix) { v <- rep(NA_real_, n); v[pos[ix]] <- d[[col]][ix]; v })
}
TSDATA <- list(
  months = format(MONTHS, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  years  = sprintf("%d-01-01", YEARS),
  m      = align(ts_m, match(ts_m$DATE, MONTHS), length(MONTHS), "VAL"),
  y      = align(ts_y, match(ts_y$YEAR, YEARS),  length(YEARS),  "VAL"),
  n      = align(ts_y, match(ts_y$YEAR, YEARS),  length(YEARS),  "NM"),
  geos   = I(GEOS),                 # I() : reste un tableau même avec un seul pays
  ind    = as.list(IND_LAB),
  flow0  = DEFAULT_FLOW
)
```

```{r helpers}
fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2013", formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ","))

theme_plotly <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      font          = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, color = COL_NAVY),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor  = "#FFFFFF",
      # Info-bulle opaque et lisible (sinon, en survol unifié, elle prend le fond transparent de la page)
      hoverlabel    = list(bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.97)", bordercolor = COL_NAVY, align = "left",

}

# Une courbe par pays ; produit, indicateur et fréquence sont remplis par le script de la page
plot_timeseries <- function() {
  prod <- PRODUCTS$PROD[PRODUCTS$SEL]
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (g in GEOS) {
    s <- filter(ts_m, GEO == g, PROD == prod, IND == DEFAULT_IND, FLOW == DEFAULT_FLOW)
    if (nrow(s) == 0) s <- tibble(DATE = MONTHS[1], VAL = NA_real_)
    p <- add_trace(
      p, x = s$DATE, y = s$VAL, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = g,
      line = list(color = GEO_COL[[g]], width = 2.2),
      marker = list(color = GEO_COL[[g]], size = 6, line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1.5)),
      hovertemplate = "%{fullData.name}: <b>%{y:,.0f}</b><extra></extra>"
    )
  }
  p %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = c(axis_style, list(
        title = "", type = "date", hoverformat = "%B %Y",
        showspikes = TRUE, spikemode = "across", spikesnap = "cursor", spikethickness = 1, spikedash = "dot", spikecolor = COL_GREY,
        rangeselector = list(
          buttons = list(
            list(count = 1,  label = "1 an",   step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 5,  label = "5 ans",  step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(count = 10, label = "10 ans", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
            list(step = "all", label = "Tout")),
          font = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = 11), bgcolor = "#EEF9FD", activecolor = "#BDE6F7")
      )),
      yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = IND_LAB[[DEFAULT_IND]], rangemode = "tozero")),
      hovermode = "x unified", showlegend = FALSE,
      margin = list(t = 10, l = 10, b = 30)
    ) %>%
    theme_plotly() %>%
    { .$height <- 540; . }
}
```

```{r pq-data}
# ==== Partie 2 : prix unitaires et quantités (un seul pays, LU par défaut) ====================
# Prix unitaire = valeur (€) / quantité ; variations mensuelles en log ; régression dlog(Q) ~ dlog(P)
PQ_GEO <- toupper(trimws(params$pq_geo))
PQ_MIN <- max(3L, as.integer(params$pq_min_obs))
up_ind <- toupper(IND_CODES)
V_IND  <- IND_CODES[str_detect(up_ind, "EURO")][1]
Q_IND  <- c(IND_CODES[str_detect(up_ind, "100 ?KG")], IND_CODES[str_detect(up_ind, "KG")])[1]
Q_UNIT <- if (is.na(Q_IND)) "" else if (str_detect(toupper(Q_IND), "100 ?KG")) "100 kg" else "kg"

PQ_MSG <- NULL
if (is.na(V_IND) || is.na(Q_IND)) {
  PQ_MSG <- sprintf("Indicateurs valeur (€) et quantité (kg) introuvables. Indicateurs disponibles : %s.",
                    paste(IND_CODES, collapse = ", "))
} else if (is.na(COLS$geo) || !PQ_GEO %in% toupper(dat_allgeo$GEO)) {
  PQ_MSG <- sprintf("Pays %s introuvable dans les données.", PQ_GEO)
}

pq <- tibble()
if (is.null(PQ_MSG)) {
  pq <- dat_allgeo %>%
    filter(toupper(GEO) == PQ_GEO, IND %in% c(V_IND, Q_IND)) %>%
    mutate(IND = if_else(IND == V_IND, "V", "Q")) %>%
    group_by(PROD, FLOW, DATE, IND) %>%
    summarise(VAL = sum(VAL), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = IND, values_from = VAL)
  for (cl in c("V", "Q")) if (!cl %in% names(pq)) pq[[cl]] <- NA_real_

  pq <- pq %>%
    filter(V > 0, Q > 0) %>%                                        # mois avec valeur ET quantité positives
    arrange(PROD, FLOW, DATE) %>%
    group_by(PROD, FLOW) %>%
    mutate(
      P   = V / Q,
      MI  = as.integer(format(DATE, "%Y")) * 12L + as.integer(format(DATE, "%m")),
      CON = (MI - lag(MI)) == 1L,                                   # variation calculée sur deux mois consécutifs uniquement
      dP  = if_else(CON, log(P) - lag(log(P)), NA_real_),
      dQ  = if_else(CON, log(Q) - lag(log(Q)), NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  if (nrow(pq) == 0) PQ_MSG <- sprintf("Aucun mois avec une valeur et une quantité positives pour %s.", PQ_GEO)
}
PQ_OK <- is.null(PQ_MSG)

# Régression dlog(Q) = a + b * dlog(P) ; b = « élasticité » apparente
fit_pq <- function(dp, dq) {
  ok <- is.finite(dp) & is.finite(dq)
  n  <- sum(ok)
  if (n < PQ_MIN || !isTRUE(sd(dp[ok]) > 0)) return(list(n = n))
  m  <- summary(lm(dq[ok] ~ dp[ok]))
  cf <- m$coefficients
  b  <- cf[2, 1]; se <- cf[2, 2]; tq <- qt(0.975, n - 2)
  lapply(list(n = n, a = cf[1, 1], b = b, se = se, lo = b - tq * se, hi = b + tq * se,
              r2 = m$r.squared, pv = cf[2, 4]), function(x) signif(x, 6))
}

K_EMPTY <- list(d = NA_character_, p = NA_real_, q = NA_real_, dp = NA_real_, dq = NA_real_, s = list(n = 0))

if (PQ_OK) {
  PQ_PRODUCTS <- dat_allgeo %>%
    filter(PROD %in% pq$PROD) %>%
    distinct(PROD, PLABEL) %>%
    distinct(PROD, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(PROD) %>%
    mutate(DISPLAY = if_else(duplicated(PLABEL) | duplicated(PLABEL, fromLast = TRUE),
                             paste0(PLABEL, " (", PROD, ")"), PLABEL))
  hit <- head(c(which(key(PQ_PRODUCTS$PROD) == key(params$product) | key(PQ_PRODUCTS$PLABEL) == key(params$product)),
                which(toupper(PQ_PRODUCTS$PROD) == "TOTAL"), 1L), 1)
  PQ_PRODUCTS$SEL <- seq_len(nrow(PQ_PRODUCTS)) == hit

  PQ_FLOWS <- FLOW_CODES[FLOW_CODES %in% pq$FLOW]
  PQ_FLOW0 <- if (DEFAULT_FLOW %in% PQ_FLOWS) DEFAULT_FLOW else PQ_FLOWS[1]

  sig6 <- function(x) I(signif(x, 6))                               # I() : toujours un tableau en JSON
  PQDATA <- list(
    flows = as.list(FLOW_LAB[PQ_FLOWS]),
    flow0 = PQ_FLOW0,
    k = lapply(split(pq, paste(pq$PROD, pq$FLOW, sep = "|")), function(d) list(
      d  = I(format(d$DATE, "%Y-%m-01")),
      p  = sig6(d$P), q = sig6(d$Q), dp = sig6(d$dP), dq = sig6(d$dQ),
      s  = fit_pq(d$dP, d$dQ)
    ))
  )
  K0 <- PQDATA$k[[paste(PQ_PRODUCTS$PROD[PQ_PRODUCTS$SEL], PQ_FLOW0, sep = "|")]]
  if (is.null(K0)) K0 <- K_EMPTY
}

COL_PRICE <- COL_PINK
spike_x   <- list(showspikes = TRUE, spikemode = "across", spikesnap = "cursor", spikethickness = 1,
                  spikedash = "dot", spikecolor = COL_GREY)

# Graphique 1 : quantité (axe gauche) et prix unitaire (axe droit) dans le temps
pq_ts_plot <- function(k) {
  x <- as.Date(as.character(k$d))
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(x = x, y = as.numeric(k$q), type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = paste0("Quantité (", Q_UNIT, ")"),
              line = list(color = COL_BLUE, width = 2),
              hovertemplate = "Quantité : <b>%{y:,.0f}</b><extra></extra>") %>%
    add_trace(x = x, y = as.numeric(k$p), type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = paste0("Prix unitaire (€ / ", Q_UNIT, ")"),
              yaxis = "y2", line = list(color = COL_PRICE, width = 2),
              hovertemplate = "Prix unitaire : <b>%{y:,.2f} €</b><extra></extra>") %>%
    layout(
      xaxis  = c(axis_style, list(title = "", type = "date", hoverformat = "%B %Y"), spike_x),
      yaxis  = c(axis_style, list(title = list(text = paste0("Quantité (", Q_UNIT, ")"), font = list(color = COL_BLUE)),
                                  rangemode = "tozero")),
      yaxis2 = list(title = list(text = paste0("Prix unitaire (€ / ", Q_UNIT, ")"), font = list(color = COL_PRICE)),
                    overlaying = "y", side = "right", showgrid = FALSE, rangemode = "tozero", linecolor = COL_NAVY),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = 1.12, yanchor = "bottom"),
      margin = list(t = 30, l = 10, r = 70, b = 30)
    ) %>%
    theme_plotly() %>%
    { .$height <- 420; . }
}

# Graphique 2 : nuage dlog(P) / dlog(Q) + droite de régression
pq_sc_plot <- function(k) {
  dp <- as.numeric(k$dp); dq <- as.numeric(k$dq)
  ok <- is.finite(dp) & is.finite(dq)
  s  <- k$s
  lx <- if (!is.null(s$b) && any(ok)) range(dp[ok]) else NA_real_
  ly <- if (!is.null(s$b) && any(ok)) s$a + s$b * lx else NA_real_
  zero <- list(zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#B8B4D9", zerolinewidth = 1.5, tickformat = ".0%")
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(x = dp[ok], y = dq[ok], customdata = as.character(k$d)[ok], type = "scatter", mode = "markers", name = "Mois",
              marker = list(color = COL_BLUE, opacity = 0.55, size = 7, line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
              hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<br>Prix : <b>%{x:+.1%}</b><br>Quantité : <b>%{y:+.1%}</b><extra></extra>") %>%
    add_trace(x = lx, y = ly, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = "Régression",
              line = list(color = COL_NAVY, width = 2.5), hoverinfo = "skip") %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = modifyList(axis_style, c(list(title = "Variation mensuelle du prix unitaire (log)"), zero)),
      yaxis = modifyList(axis_style, c(list(title = "Variation mensuelle de la quantité (log)"), zero)),
      hovermode = "closest", showlegend = FALSE,
      margin = list(t = 10, l = 10, r = 10, b = 40)
    ) %>%
    theme_plotly() %>%
    { .$height <- 420; . }
}
```

```{r cockpit}
btn_group <- function(label, cls, items, active, extra = NULL) {
  div(class = "f-group",
      span(class = "f-label", label),
      div(class = "f-row",
          lapply(seq_along(items), function(i) {
            tags$button(type = "button", class = paste("xc-btn", cls, if (names(items)[i] %in% active) "active"),
                        `data-v` = names(items)[i], if (!is.null(extra)) extra(names(items)[i]), items[[i]])
          })))
}

geo_filter <- btn_group("Pays", "geo-btn", setNames(as.list(GEOS), GEOS), GEOS,
                        extra = function(g) span(class = "geo-dot", style = paste0("background:", GEO_COL[[g]], ";")))
ind_filter  <- btn_group("Indicateur", "ind-btn", as.list(IND_LAB), DEFAULT_IND)
freq_filter <- btn_group("Fréquence", "freq-btn", list(m = "Mensuel", y = "Annuel"), DEFAULT_FREQ)

# Menu déroulant à choix unique (un par partie : classes et nom de groupe distincts)
make_dd <- function(products, chk_class, radio_name, label = "Produit") {
  div(
    class = "f-group",
    span(class = "f-label", label),
    div(
      class = "dd",
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "dd-toggle", span(class = "dd-text", "…"), span(class = "dd-caret", "▾")),
      div(
        class = "dd-panel",
        tags$input(type = "search", class = "dd-search", placeholder = "Rechercher un produit (nom ou code)…"),
        div(class = "dd-list",
            lapply(seq_len(nrow(products)), function(i) {
              tags$label(
                class = "prod-item", `data-name` = tolower(paste(products$PROD[i], products$DISPLAY[i])),
                `data-label` = products$DISPLAY[i], title = products$DISPLAY[i],
                tags$input(type = "radio", name = radio_name, class = chk_class, value = products$PROD[i],
                           checked = if (products$SEL[i]) NA else NULL),
                if (products$PROD[i] != products$DISPLAY[i]) span(class = "code", products$PROD[i]),
                span(products$DISPLAY[i])
              )
            }))
      )
    )
  )
}

prod_filter <- make_dd(PRODUCTS, "prod-chk", "prod-radio")

}

        div(class = "pq-stats",

            pq_stat("st-n", "Mois utilisés"),
            pq_stat("st-ci", "IC 95 % de b", wide = TRUE),
            pq_stat("st-r2", "R²"),
            pq_stat("st-p", "p-value")),
        div(class = "pq-interp", ""),
        div(class = "note", style = "margin-top:12px;",
            "Prix unitaire = valeur / quantité : c'est une valeur unitaire, qui bouge aussi quand la composition du produit change. ",
            "Comme le prix est calculé à partir de la quantité, le bruit sur la quantité pousse mécaniquement b vers le négatif. ",
            "Les variations mensuelles restent marquées par la saisonnalité, et la relation est une corrélation, pas une élasticité de demande."))
  ),
  div(class = "pq-sub", style = "margin-top:22px;", "Tous les produits"),
  div(class = "note", style = "margin:0 0 8px 0;",
```

```{r select-script, results='asis'}
js <- "
  var D = window.TSDATA;
  var root = document.querySelector('.ts-section');       // partie 1 uniquement
  if (!root || !D) return;
  var NC = D.geos.length;
  var dd = root.querySelector('.dd');
  if (!dd) return;

  function items() { return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.prod-item')); }
  function active(cls) { var b = root.querySelector('.' + cls + '.active'); return b ? b.dataset.v : null; }

  function update() {
    var gd = root.querySelector('.ts-chart .js-plotly-plot');
    if (!window.Plotly || !gd || !gd.data) return setTimeout(update, 200);

    var chk  = root.querySelector('.prod-chk:checked');
    var prod = chk ? chk.value : null;
    var lbl  = chk ? chk.closest('.prod-item').dataset.label : 'Choisir un produit';
    var ind  = active('ind-btn'), fr = active('freq-btn') || 'm', flow = active('flow-btn') || D.flow0;
    var gBtn = root.querySelectorAll('.geo-btn');

    var xs = [], ys = [], cds = [], vis = [], mx = 0, any = false;
    var X = fr === 'm' ? D.months : D.years;
    for (var j = 0; j < NC; j++) {
      var k = D.geos[j] + '|' + prod + '|' + ind + '|' + flow;
      var y = (fr === 'm' ? D.m : D.y)[k], nm = D.n[k];
      var on = (gBtn.length ? gBtn[j].classList.contains('active') : true) && !!y;
      xs.push(X);
      ys.push(y || X.map(function () { return null; }));
      cds.push(X.map(function (_, i) {
        return (fr === 'y' && nm && nm[i] && nm[i] < 12) ? ' \u00b7 année incomplète (' + nm[i] + ' mois)' : '';
      }));
      vis.push(on);
      if (on) { any = true; y.forEach(function (v) { if (v !== null && Math.abs(v) > mx) mx = Math.abs(v); }); }
    }
    var f  = mx >= 1000 ? ',.0f' : ',.2f';
    var ht = '%{fullData.name}: <b>%{y:' + f + '}</b>%{customdata}<extra></extra>';
    var idx = []; for (var i = 0; i < NC; i++) idx.push(i);

    Plotly.restyle(gd, { x: xs, y: ys, customdata: cds, visible: vis,
                         mode: fr === 'y' ? 'lines+markers' : 'lines', hovertemplate: ht }, idx);
    Plotly.relayout(gd, { 'yaxis.title.text': D.ind[ind] || ind, 'xaxis.hoverformat': fr === 'm' ? '%B %Y' : '%Y',
                          'xaxis.autorange': true, 'yaxis.autorange': true });

    root.querySelector('.ts-empty').style.display = any ? 'none' : 'block';
    dd.querySelector('.dd-text').textContent = lbl;
    root.querySelector('.card-title').textContent = lbl;
  }

  // Menu déroulant produit : ouverture / fermeture, recherche, choix unique
  dd.querySelector('.dd-toggle').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    dd.classList.toggle('open');
    if (dd.classList.contains('open')) dd.querySelector('.dd-search').focus();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!dd.contains(e.target)) dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  dd.querySelector('.dd-search').addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    items().forEach(function (it) { it.style.display = (!q || it.dataset.name.indexOf(q) !== -1) ? '' : 'none'; });
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('.prod-chk').forEach(function (c) {
    c.addEventListener('change', function () { update(); dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  });

  // Indicateur et fréquence : un seul bouton actif
  ['ind-btn', 'freq-btn', 'flow-btn'].forEach(function (cls) {
    root.querySelectorAll('.' + cls).forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        root.querySelectorAll('.' + cls).forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('active', o === b); });
        update();
      });
    });
  });

  // Pays : LU, BE ou les deux (au moins un reste actif)
  root.querySelectorAll('.geo-btn').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      b.classList.toggle('active');
      if (!root.querySelector('.geo-btn.active')) b.classList.add('active');
      update();
    });
  });

  update();
"
cat("<script>\n(function(){ function go(){", js, "}\nif (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(go, 0); else window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(go, 0); }); })();\n</script>\n")
```

```{r pq-script, results='asis'}
js_pq <- "
  var P = window.PQDATA, MIN = __MIN__;
  var root = document.querySelector('.pq-section');        // partie 2 uniquement
  if (!root || !P) return;
  var dd = root.querySelector('.dd');
  var DIR0 = { label: 1, n: -1, b: 1, ci: 1, r2: -1, pv: 1 };   // sens de tri par défaut de chaque colonne
  var sort = { k: 'b', dir: 1 };

  function items() { return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.prod-item')); }
  function arr(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v == null ? [] : [v]); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>\"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '\"': '&quot;' }[c]; }); }
  function flow() { var b = root.querySelector('.pq-flow-btn.active'); return b ? b.dataset.v : P.flow0; }
  function fmt(x, d) {
    return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? '\\u2013' : Number(x).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { minimumFractionDigits: d, maximumFractionDigits: d });
  }
  function fmtP(p) { return p == null ? '\\u2013' : (p < 0.001 ? '< 0,001' : fmt(p, 3)); }
  function month(d) { return new Date(d + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }); }
  function est(s) { return (s && s.b != null) ? s : null; }

  function setStat(cls, v) { root.querySelector('.' + cls + ' .v').textContent = v; }
  function stats(s) {
    var e = est(s), n = s ? s.n : 0;
    setStat('st-b',  e ? fmt(e.b, 2) : '\\u2013');
    setStat('st-n',  fmt(n, 0));
    setStat('st-ci', e ? '[' + fmt(e.lo, 2) + ' ; ' + fmt(e.hi, 2) + ']' : '\\u2013');
    setStat('st-r2', e ? fmt(e.r2, 2) : '\\u2013');
    setStat('st-p',  e ? fmtP(e.pv) : '\\u2013');
    var t = root.querySelector('.pq-interp');
    if (!e) {
      t.className = 'pq-interp muted';
      t.textContent = 'Pas assez de mois exploitables (' + n + ' < ' + MIN + ') pour estimer la relation.';
      return;
    }
    t.className = 'pq-interp';
    t.innerHTML = 'Une hausse de 1 % du prix unitaire va de pair, le même mois, avec une variation de <b>' +
      (e.b >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(e.b, 2) + ' %</b> de la quantité. ' +
      (e.pv < 0.05 ? 'Relation <b>significative</b> au seuil de 5 %.' : 'Relation <b>non significative</b> au seuil de 5 %.');
  }

  function renderTable(prod, fl) {
    var rows = items().map(function (it) {
      var c = it.querySelector('.pq-chk').value, k = P.k[c + '|' + fl], s = k ? k.s : null;
      return { code: c, label: it.dataset.label, n: s ? s.n : 0, s: est(s) };
    });
    var key = sort.k, dir = sort.dir;
    function val(r) { return key === 'n' ? r.n : (r.s ? r.s[key === 'ci' ? 'lo' : key] : null); }
    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      if (key === 'label') return dir * a.label.localeCompare(b.label, 'fr');
      var va = val(a), vb = val(b);
      if (va == null && vb == null) return a.label.localeCompare(b.label, 'fr');
      if (va == null) return 1;
      if (vb == null) return -1;
      return dir * (va - vb);
    });
    root.querySelector('.pq-table tbody').innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
      var s = r.s, sig = s && s.pv < 0.05;
      return '<tr data-code=\"' + esc(r.code) + '\" class=\"' + (r.code === prod ? 'current' : '') + (s ? '' : ' na') + '\">' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.label) + '</td>' +
        '<td class=\"num\">' + fmt(r.n, 0) + '</td>' +
        '<td class=\"num' + (sig ? ' sig' : '') + '\">' + (s ? fmt(s.b, 2) + (sig ? '<span class=\"sig-dot\"></span>' : '') : 'n < ' + MIN) + '</td>' +
        '<td class=\"num\">' + (s ? '[' + fmt(s.lo, 2) + ' ; ' + fmt(s.hi, 2) + ']' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class=\"num\">' + (s ? fmt(s.r2, 2) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class=\"num\">' + (s ? fmtP(s.pv) : '') + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');
    root.querySelectorAll('.pq-table th').forEach(function (th) {
      th.classList.toggle('sorted', th.dataset.k === key);
      th.classList.toggle('asc', th.dataset.k === key && dir === 1);
    });
  }

  function update() {
    var g1 = root.querySelector('.pq-ts .js-plotly-plot'), g2 = root.querySelector('.pq-sc .js-plotly-plot');
    if (!window.Plotly || !g1 || !g1.data || !g2 || !g2.data) return setTimeout(update, 200);

    var chk = root.querySelector('.pq-chk:checked'), prod = chk ? chk.value : null;
    var lbl = chk ? chk.closest('.prod-item').dataset.label : 'Choisir un produit';
    var fl = flow(), k = P.k[prod + '|' + fl] || null;
    dd.querySelector('.dd-text').textContent = lbl;
    root.querySelector('.pq-title').textContent = lbl + ' \\u00b7 ' + (P.flows[fl] || fl);

    var d = k ? arr(k.d) : [], p = k ? arr(k.p) : [], q = k ? arr(k.q) : [], dp = k ? arr(k.dp) : [], dq = k ? arr(k.dq) : [];
    Plotly.restyle(g1, { x: [d, d], y: [q, p] }, [0, 1]);
    Plotly.relayout(g1, { 'xaxis.autorange': true, 'yaxis.autorange': true, 'yaxis2.autorange': true });

    var xs = [], ys = [], cd = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
      if (dp[i] != null && dq[i] != null) { xs.push(dp[i]); ys.push(dq[i]); cd.push(month(d[i])); }
    }
    var e = est(k ? k.s : null), lx = [], ly = [];
    if (e && xs.length) {
      var mn = Math.min.apply(null, xs), mx = Math.max.apply(null, xs);
      lx = [mn, mx]; ly = [e.a + e.b * mn, e.a + e.b * mx];
    }
    Plotly.restyle(g2, { x: [xs, lx], y: [ys, ly], customdata: [cd, []] }, [0, 1]);
    Plotly.relayout(g2, { 'xaxis.autorange': true, 'yaxis.autorange': true });

    stats(k ? k.s : null);
    root.querySelector('.pq-empty').style.display = (d.length && d[0] != null) ? 'none' : 'block';
    renderTable(prod, fl);
  }

  // Menu déroulant produit
  dd.querySelector('.dd-toggle').addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    dd.classList.toggle('open');
    if (dd.classList.contains('open')) dd.querySelector('.dd-search').focus();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { if (!dd.contains(ev.target)) dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) { if (ev.key === 'Escape') dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  dd.querySelector('.dd-search').addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = this.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    items().forEach(function (it) { it.style.display = (!q || it.dataset.name.indexOf(q) !== -1) ? '' : 'none'; });
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('.pq-chk').forEach(function (c) {
    c.addEventListener('change', function () { update(); dd.classList.remove('open'); });
  });

  // Flux : Import ou Export
  root.querySelectorAll('.pq-flow-btn').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      root.querySelectorAll('.pq-flow-btn').forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('active', o === b); });
      update();
    });
  });

  // Tableau : tri par en-tête, clic sur une ligne = afficher le produit
  root.querySelectorAll('.pq-table th').forEach(function (th) {
    th.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var k = th.dataset.k;
      sort = (sort.k === k) ? { k: k, dir: -sort.dir } : { k: k, dir: DIR0[k] };
      update();
    });
  });
  root.querySelector('.pq-table tbody').addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    var tr = ev.target.closest('tr');
    if (!tr) return;
    var code = tr.dataset.code;
    root.querySelectorAll('.pq-chk').forEach(function (c) { c.checked = (c.value === code); });
    update();
    root.querySelector('.pq-title').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

  update();
"
js_pq <- sub("__MIN__", as.character(PQ_MIN), js_pq, fixed = TRUE)
if (PQ_OK) cat("<script>\n(function(){ function go(){", js_pq, "}\nif (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(go, 0); else window.addEventListener('load', function(){ setTimeout(go, 0); }); })();\n</script>\n")
```
